Name: D_0
dialogue: It made my day finding this chair in a dumpster.

Name: D_1
dialogue: I cleaned it thoroughly but the smell of urine and grease won’t leave.

Name: D_2
dialogue: The worst part is I don’t know if that smell came from a hobo near the dumpster, or the previous owner.

Name: D_3
dialogue: And of course the main computer, where all the magic happens.

Name: D_4
dialogue: I turned the case of an old TV into my computer display.

Name: D_5
dialogue: Needed some help from Bailey since she is the computer engineer.

Name: D_6
dialogue: Making a display with more that just ducttape is more than my brain can handle.
